boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase reading, art, and study stops on or close to Tufts’ Medford/Somerville campus.

cards.title: Look through a gallery exhibition
cards.subtitle: Aidekman Arts Center, 40 Talbot Avenue
cards.notes: Meet during posted gallery hours, take in the current exhibition at your own pace, then compare which work held your attention longest.
cards.short_summary: A free, public Medford gallery visit with an easy conversation starter.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts University Art Galleries’ Medford location is free and open to all.
cards.access_notes: The gallery lists free admission; check its visit page for current exhibition hours and closures.

cards.title: Browse Tisch’s onsite collections
cards.subtitle: 35 Professors Row, Medford/Somerville campus
cards.notes: Choose a shelf or display to browse together, then settle in with a few finds for a quiet, screen-free break between classes.
cards.short_summary: A public campus library for a low-key browsing session.
cards.evidence_claim: Tisch Library is open to the public, and onsite visitors may use its collections and public computers.
cards.access_notes: Public use is permitted; borrowing privileges differ by visitor account, so plan to use materials onsite.

cards.title: Page through music scores at Lilly
cards.subtitle: Granoff Music Center, Medford/Somerville campus
cards.notes: Bring a friend to browse performance and study scores or music media, and pick a cover or composer to investigate together.
cards.short_summary: A music-focused library stop inside the Granoff Music Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Lilly Music Library is on the Medford/Somerville campus, holds scores and media collections, and Tufts libraries are open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Check current Lilly Music Library hours before visiting; lending rules may differ from onsite use.

cards.title: Browse global-affairs research at Ginn
cards.subtitle: The Fletcher School, Medford/Somerville campus
cards.notes: Use a table as a meeting point, then browse a topic that interests both of you—from human rights to international security.
cards.short_summary: A specialized Fletcher library for an intellectually curious hang.
cards.evidence_claim: Edwin Ginn Library is on the Medford/Somerville campus, and Tufts libraries are open to the public.
cards.source_title: Borrowing Items from Other Tufts Libraries | Tisch Library
cards.access_notes: Public access is listed by Tufts; check current building hours and use collections onsite unless eligible to borrow.

cards.title: Plan an archives visit
cards.subtitle: Tisch Library, Medford/Somerville campus
cards.notes: Choose a campus-history or manuscript topic together, then consult the center’s guidance before visiting to use primary-source materials responsibly.
cards.short_summary: A public university archive for a research-oriented meet-up.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tufts Archival Research Center is Tufts’ archives and manuscript repository and is open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Review current research and appointment procedures before arrival; collection handling rules apply.

cards.entity_name: Open Practice Rooms at Granoff Music Center
cards.title: Make music in an open practice room
cards.subtitle: Granoff Music Center, Medford/Somerville campus
cards.notes: If you are a Tufts affiliate, bring an instrument or warm up your voice with a friend in an unlocked room during building open hours.
cards.short_summary: A first-come, first-served music activity for Tufts affiliates.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts’ open practice rooms are available to all Tufts affiliates free of charge during Granoff Music Center open hours.
cards.access_notes: Available only to Tufts affiliates, first come first served, during Granoff Music Center open hours.

cards.title: Settle in at the Central Library
cards.subtitle: 79 Highland Avenue, Somerville
cards.notes: Pick a shared table for reading, planning, or conversation at a low volume, then take a short walk through the nearby neighborhood.
cards.short_summary: A public library near campus with evening weekday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Somerville Public Library locations are open to the public and provide free access to library spaces, resources, and programs.
cards.access_notes: Use during posted Central Library hours; the library is closed on designated holidays.

cards.title: Browse at the East Branch
cards.subtitle: Gold Star Memorial, Somerville
cards.notes: Meet up to browse titles, work quietly, or trade reading recommendations; keep phone calls outside so the shared space stays usable.
cards.short_summary: A smaller public-library stop for a calm, no-cost catch-up.
cards.evidence_claim: Somerville Public Library locations are open to the public and provide free access to library spaces, resources, and programs.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the East Branch’s current hours before traveling; standard library conduct rules apply.

cards.title: Read together at the West Branch
cards.subtitle: West Somerville, Somerville
cards.notes: Bring a current book or choose something from the shelves, then spend an hour reading side by side without needing to buy anything.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood branch for a quiet shared-reading break.
cards.evidence_claim: Somerville Public Library locations are open to the public and provide free access to library spaces, resources, and programs.
cards.access_notes: Check current West Branch hours before going; use shared areas respectfully.

cards.entity_name: Charlotte and William Bloomberg Medford Public Library
cards.title: Browse the Medford Public Library
cards.subtitle: Medford
cards.notes: Meet among the physical collections, choose a topic to explore together, and use materials in the building without checking anything out.
cards.short_summary: A local public-library hang with unrestricted in-library material use.
cards.evidence_claim: Medford Public Library provides free access to physical and digital collections, and use of materials within the library is unrestricted.
cards.source_title: Collection Development Policy | Medford Public Library
cards.access_notes: In-library use is unrestricted; some digital resources and borrowing privileges have separate eligibility rules.
